sentences.text: Have you ever felt someone walking softly behind you?
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: At the village wedding feast, the old tales say a rare blue moon rose and opened a door that is normally shut.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Suddenly a bride was missing, and the party went entirely quiet as cold wind swept the floor.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Footprints appeared on the dirt road, leaving silk threads where a giant spider creature had stalked its prey.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: A terrified bridesmaid ran through the shadows, whispering a warning to the empty forest.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Open the gate, it is only me.
sentences.speaker: mimic

sentences.text: The dark monster lunged from the dark with flashing red eyes.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Only torn silk and a dropped lantern remained in the mud.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Will you dare lock your door tonight when something scratches outside?
sentences.speaker: narrator
